not_covered.text: Israeli airstrikes on the Gaza Strip kill a family of four.
Russia launches drone strikes at Ukraine, killing at least seven people.

not_covered.topic: Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war
not_covered.text: Crude oil prices in the United States, including from Brent Crude and West Texas Intermediate, reach US$100, the highest since May, amidst renewed tensions between the U.S. and Iran.

not_covered.topic: Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war
not_covered.text: The International Monetary Fund reports that the global growth of the global economy is on track to reach 3% in 2026 despite the war in Iran, but also cautioned that risks still remain high.
Seven more children died from suspected measles in Bangladesh in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of deaths in the country to 1,009.
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Sardar Md. Sakhawat Husain announces that Bangladesh will resume nationwide vaccinations beginning on September 25 amidst the ongoing measles outbreak.
Algeria cuts diplomatic relations with the United Arab Emirates, without specifying a reason.

not_covered.topic: Latin America–United States relations, War on drugs
not_covered.text: Peruvian president Keiko Fujimori announces that the country will join the Shield of the Americas coalition against drug cartels following a visit from U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
Switzerland publishes a 200-page dossier on the Nazi war criminal Josef Mengele, who conducted medical experiments at Auschwitz concentration camp.
